steps.title: Define Cat Play Toy Metadata
steps.description: Create app-meta.json detailing the configuration metadata for the application Cat Play Toy.

steps.title: Configure build.gradle
steps.description: Establish build dependencies and compile parameters for Cat Play Toy ensuring compliance with Java 1.8 compile compatibility, SDK version 34, and Gradle 8.5.

steps.title: Create AndroidManifest.xml
steps.description: Create application manifest configurations defining the main activity class com.catplaytoy.app.MainActivity, setting fixed portrait orientation suitable for cat play, and using standard drawable icons.

steps.title: Design Layout activity_main.xml
steps.description: Create UI containing the navigation tabs for switching modes, structural scoreboards for storing cat statistics, layouts for sound boards, and key overlays for the cat piano.

steps.title: Implement Audio Synthesizer Engine
steps.description: Write native sound synthesis routines in com.catplaytoy.app.MainActivity to programmatically construct PCM 16bit audio arrays representing meows, purrs, growls, bird chirping, and mouse squeaking.

steps.title: Implement Custom Canvas CatToyView
steps.description: Create a high performance drawing view com.catplaytoy.app.CatToyView utilizing Android Canvas routines to draw, rotate, swim fishes, animate custom red laser glows, and compute accurate cat-paw taps.

steps.title: Implement High Score Persistence
steps.description: Code persistent score caching using Shared Preferences to store the peak points scored by cat paw taps inside com.catplaytoy.app.MainActivity.

steps.title: Build Soundboard Input Handler
steps.description: Implement grid action listeners binding raw audio synthesizer methods to layout elements.

steps.title: Build Dynamic Cat Piano Input Handler
steps.description: Formulate scaled pitch factor equations within the piano keyboard touch callbacks to vary the meow pitch correctly across standard musical scales.

steps.title: Integrate Navigation Layout Swapper
steps.description: Map tab click callbacks to programmatically change layout visibility and toggle game loop modes inside the workspace container.

steps.title: Verify Java Standard 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Conduct syntax inspection of MainActivity and custom views to verify that no unsupported Java 9+ features or lambda expressions are used.

steps.title: Conduct Manifest Namespace Verification
steps.description: Validate Android Manifest namespaces ensuring correctness to prevent compilation errors.

steps.title: Building Cat Play Toy
steps.description: Compile the complete resources and assembly code to build Cat Play Toy Debug APK.
